title: BRIARFIELD AQUATIC CENTRE: LEARN TO SWIM REGISTRATION
summary: This is a registration for one place in an eight week Learn to Swim session at Briarfield Aquatic Centre, at a flat one hundred and twenty dollars paid when the place is booked. The fee covers the eight lessons, pool entry on lesson days and a progress card, and the registration says nothing else is charged. The Centre offers a make-up lesson or a fifteen dollar refund for a lesson it cancels, and allows a missed lesson to be made up where a place is free. A place given up more than seven days ahead is refunded in full, half the fee up to the third lesson, and nothing after that. The session ends after the eighth lesson and does not continue, so the next session means registering again.
